answer: Each account must erect one crystal trellis on a registered garden ledge. The smith sets crystal panes into the trellis frame and signs the erection record with the trellis serial mark. Two verifiers check the record against the garden register within a week, and a record tied to a second account voids both claims. The trellis and crystal cost 3,500,000 rupiah, so 1,000 fake identities would spend 3,500,000,000 rupiah.
